verdict.rationale: Mercury Books documents linking external bank accounts and cards, and says transactions are pulled in and reconciled automatically in real time. However, the automatic-import language describes Mercury's own banking, invoicing and bill pay data. For external linked accounts, the docs give only a one-line linking claim with no stated import cadence or sync mechanics. missing for 10: explicit documentation that transactions from linked external bank and credit-card accounts import automatically on a daily or continuous schedule, details of the connection mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Link external bank accounts, cards, payroll platforms, and more for the complete story of your business.
All your transactions across banking, invoicing, bill pay, and more are pulled in automatically as you build your business.
Accounts reconcile in real time, always reflecting your company's reality, without manual work.
